name: Infra Claude Code plugin: skill, guard hook, offline validate hook
description:
Claude Code plugin for the infra CLI, generated like the docs and issues plugins. Design: docs show infra-cli/claude-plugin.

- `infra generate-plugin` from InfraPlugin.cs via PluginGenerator: plugins/infra (skill + hooks/hooks.json), marketplace entry, marketplace description becomes 'issues, docs and infra CLIs'. Exit-code table from InfraExitCodes (adds 5, 6). `infra hook` left out of the command table.
- Skill: authoring-first (point at @infra stubs; seven traps: Output<T> opaque, sandbox, secret refs, env branches, `--` names and no protect/export on firewall/ssh key/registry, removal deletes unless protected, runtime-only validation) plus operating (`--json` everywhere, plan summary with counts and every delete/replace/protected/drift line before any apply in the same turn, secrets set only via the user's `! infra secrets set`). Trigger description per the design.
- `infra hook bash` (PreToolUse, matcher Bash|PowerShell, onFailure block): split on ; && || | newlines, classify every infra/infra.exe segment, strictest wins. ask: apply, adopt, destroy, restore (not --list), db copy, secrets set/init/recipients add/remove, --accept-new-hosts. deny: secrets show. Unclassifiable infra mention: ask. ask becomes deny (run it yourself with !) in bypassPermissions, acceptEdits, dontAsk or unknown modes; if the hook input lacks the mode, deny outside default/auto.
- `infra validate --offline`: skip msbuild build checks, cached repos only, no fetch; uncached gives repo-unavailable warning.
- `infra hook edit` (PostToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit, .repo-infra/**/*.luau only): runs the offline validation; errors block with file:line code message, warnings as context, clean silent.
- Tests (NUnit): table-driven guard classifier (~30 commands), offline validate makes no msbuild/git calls, generator output includes hooks.json and exit codes 5/6.
- After building: test hook ask under bypass mode by hand and record the result as a docs gotcha.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.text: Built: InfraPlugin.cs, plugins/infra (generated), infra hook shell|edit, validate --offline, tests (all 1202 pass). Deviations from the issue text, recorded in docs infra-cli/claude-plugin: no onFailure block (guard fails closed itself; a missing infra on PATH would block every shell call), event named shell not bash, an infra mention only asks behind a launcher or variable, edit hook hides repo-unavailable and checks every env. Left: install the plugin and confirm by hand that ask prompts in default mode.
